scope: CUHK official course, programme, timetable and equivalency sources
finding: No documented, current, public CUHK REST/JSON API or complete downloadable course database was found. The official data is split across CUSIS, Registry web forms, programme documents, SharePoint and departmental course-outline pages.

sources.name: CUSIS Browse Course Catalog / Programme Information
sources.recommendedUse: Canonical catalog and enrolment-rule source; crawl with the student's authenticated session after manual login.
limitations: No documented public API or official bulk export found
PeopleSoft session and dynamic forms
Personal eligibility may additionally depend on reserved quotas and approvals

sources.name: Registry Public Teaching Timetable
sources.recommendedUse: Cross-check current term section data and validate empty CUSIS export results.
limitations: Verification code is required for each public search
Not an official bulk endpoint
Does not by itself determine whether a particular student is eligible

sources.name: Registry Planned Course Offering

observedAvailability.2024-25: populated for many legacy subject codes
observedAvailability.2025-26: empty table in sampled ACCT, FINA, MGNT, MKTG, STAT and DOTE requests
observedAvailability.2026-27: empty table in sampled ACCT, FINA, MGNT, MKTG, STAT, DOTE and DSME requests

sources.recommendedUse: Historical course-pool seed and subject-code discovery only.
limitations: The page explicitly says planning only and departments may amend records
Current sampled years are unpopulated
No class times, sections, seats or prerequisites
Legacy DSME subject naming may not reflect current DOTE codes

sources.name: AQS Undergraduate Student Handbook
sources.access: public index; course/programme detail is directed to CUSIS
sources.recommendedUse: Graduation and programme-rule layer, versioned by admission cohort.
limitations: No unified machine-readable course catalog
Individual handbook document IDs are not a stable public API

sources.name: CUHK Business School Current Students SharePoint
sources.recommendedUse: Primary verification source for business-course equivalency/substitution rules and current registration notices.
limitations: Login required
Not publicly indexable
May contain documents/lists rather than a queryable database

sources.name: CUHK Business School Undergraduate Student Guidelines
limitations: Annual document may differ from the student's admission-year scheme
Some current enrolment details still require CUSIS confirmation

sources.name: CUHK CLEAR Course Outline Repository
sources.recommendedUse: Optional enrichment for descriptions, workload and syllabus.
limitations: No public manifest or complete directory found
Department submission is inconsistent
All 244 sampled current Business School offering-course URLs for 2026T1/T2 returned 404

sources.name: Departmental Course Lists and Outlines
limitations: No university-wide schema
Coverage and update frequency vary by department

recommendedPriority: CUSIS course catalog and programme information
Business School SharePoint course equivalency information
Departmental outlines and legacy planned offerings
